text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More than 200 exhibitors to take part in the International trade fair of the southern resort of Sousse from August 16-31.
- Weaving represents 80 percent of the Tunisian handicrafts industry.

- Abdelwaheb Kasraoui named as chairman of the Societe Tunisienne des Industries de Raffinage (STIR) and Rabeh Jrad as chairman of the Societe Tunisienne de Constructions et de Reparations Mecaniques et Navales (SOCOMENA).
